scope: Coordinator preparer source, byte-bound archive, protocol parity, and pre-use gate only

preparer_review.new_sibling: Destination must be a nonexistent sibling; directory and each file use exclusive creation. Partial failures are retained and reported without cleanup or overwrite.

Supplied CI JSON headSha must equal it, run status/conclusion must be completed/success, and exactly one completed/success Quality (windows-latest) and Quality (ubuntu-24.04) job is required.
